name: @bp/beacon
description: Shared Bells & Pixels Beacon feedback SDK (client-portal-governed; decision #63). Design-system-agnostic web FeedbackPane + a canonical adapter that speaks the /api/beacon-signal envelope. The envelope contract is canonical in client-portal docs/beacon-anon-ingest-spec.md.
//consumption: Ships BUILT dist/ (committed) so consumers vendor it as a submodule and import plain JS - no build step or transpilePackages in a consumer's CI, and no .ts-across-symlink resolution snag. Rebuild dist (npm run build) whenever src changes and commit only the dist files whose content changed; CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml, npm run check:dist) fails any PR or main push whose dist is out of sync with src.

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test src/adapter.test.ts src/attachments.test.ts src/walkVerdict.test.ts src/walkClient.test.ts src/onboardingStore.test.ts src/whatsNew.test.ts src/whatsNewByDate.test.ts src/tourPlacement.test.ts src/tourFocus.test.ts src/onboardingDecide.test.ts src/userKey.test.ts
